name: Arahbo, Roar of the World — "it gains trample and gets +X/+X …, where X is its power"
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). Fired, "its power" reads "that creature's power", which the boost parser did not take for the recipient's own power, so only trample came through. Savannah Lions (2/1) is 4/3 with trample.
